comment: Reviewed pin for the wallet document shipped in assets/web/index.html. A build verifies the file against this before it is packaged, so changing the wallet requires changing this file in a reviewed commit.
frontendRef: release/2026-11-rollout-prod at a22117b (#463: shorscan.com as the explorer host; #453: failed dApp requests answer with matching error codes; #456: connect SDK 5.2.1; #461: Settings layout by screen width (the app opens its own settings screen); #459: page title and App Store notice; the light theme stays off in this build). The branch is to merge to main with a merge commit, which keeps the commit reachable.
